title: Wall Mount towel bar Hand Towel Holder 6.65-Inch Solid Brass Allied Brass
body_html:
Upgrade sink-side organization with a classic, wall mount hand towel holder crafted from solid brass to keep guest towels and washcloths within easy reach.

  • Essex collection styling: traditional, elegant look designed to coordinate with matching Essex pieces
  • Wall mount design: helps save floor space while keeping towels accessible
  • Solid brass construction: crafted from the finest solid brass materials
  • Finish flexibility: available in a wide variety of lifetime designer finishes, including statement options like Venetian Bronze, Pink, Autumn Sparkle, Lavender, and Antique Pewter
  • Install-ready: all mounting hardware included; no assembly required

Specs
Collection: Essex
Category: Towel Bars (hand towel holder)
Material: Brass
Mounting type: Wall Mount
Shape: Straight bar
Length: 6.65-Inch
Projection/Width: 3.39-Inch
Height: 2.1-Inch
Bar diameter: 0.5-Inch
Weight capacity: 5 lb
Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
Made in the USA

_previous.title: Essex Hand Towel Holder
_previous.description: This elegantly crafted wall mounted guest towel holder will add style and convenience to your bathroom décor. This guest towel holder will keep your towels within reach of the sink where they are needed. It's designed ideally for hand towels and washcloths.
